name: sno-core
description: The SNO shard format and the geometry around it: the wire payload, the 256-colour palette, the stamps, winding, outlines, triangulation, clipping, and importing 3D files (PLY, STL, OBJ, glTF, VOX) as shards, and Seeds (DECK-0008), blooms grown from SEEDO DNA. Shared by snocrash, ONOSENDAI and cyberspace-mcp.

scripts.check:dist: npm run build:dist && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- dist && test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- dist)"
